search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/AWS/CloudTrail s3.amazonaws.com 
| json "eventSource", "eventName", "sourceIPAddress", "errorCode" nodrop 
| json "requestParameters.bucketName" as bucketName
| where isBlank(errorCode) and eventSource="s3.amazonaws.com" and isPublicIP(sourceIPAddress) and (eventName matches "Put*") or (eventName matches "Create*") or (eventName matches "Delete*") or (eventName matches "Update*") 
| count_distinct(bucketName) as count 
| "S3_CrudBucketsFromPublicIp_CountEventResources" as benchmarkname 
| "EventResourceCount" as type 
| fillmissing values("S3_CrudBucketsFromPublicIp_CountEventResources") in benchmarkname, values("EventResourceCount") in type 
| toInt(count) as count
